description: HTTPS agent endpoint for the zkVerify Agent Games Proof Gatekeeper event. Verifies HMAC-signed task envelopes, makes a deterministic APPROVE/REJECT decision, generates a real Groth16 proof with snarkjs against the official gatekeeper circuit, optionally submits it to zkVerify via Kurier, and returns a signed response.
name: 0xrnld-gatekeeper
